name: carmelosantana/alpaca-bot-tools-integration
description: Isolated manifest for the WordPress integration suite. The root pins PHPUnit 13 through Pest 5; wp-phpunit (WordPress core's own test library) still targets PHPUnit 9, calling getName() and Util\Test::parseTestMethodAnnotations() that PHPUnit 10 removed, and no released yoast/phpunit-polyfills supports 13, so the suite runs on its own PHPUnit 9.
